items.name: Laughter and shout detector
items.purpose: Hears laughing, shouting and cheering in your recordings so the clip maker can rank your most excited moments higher (YAMNet, runs on the CPU, offline). Clips are made without it; excitement then uses only your voice level, your words and chat.
